Ana: I opened PR adding a short 'egress & TLS probe' appendix to private-deploy.md. Covers HSM egress checks, brief HAProxy log grep, and tiny Node/Python dev snippets. Need quick review + link sanity.
Liam: Paste the snippets here for quick review? Also call out common HSM port (16963) and vendor cert quirks.
Ana: ```bash
# test TCP egress to HSM appliance
nc -vz 10.2.1.10 16963 || echo 'egress blocked'

# HAProxy health check behind NAT
curl -sS -H 'Host: svc.internal' http://10.0.8.7:8080/health || tail -n 40 /var/log/haproxy.log
```
Priya: Add kube run pattern for folks without jumpbox: `kubectl run --rm -it --image=curlimages/curl curl-test -- sh -c 'curl -sS http://10.0.8.7:8080/health'`. Also include small note on asymmetric SNAT between clouds.
Ana: Added kube example and one-liner about SNAT differences. Node snippet (dev only):
```js
// dev-only TLS-fallback (NOT FOR PROD)
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference-sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ baseUrl: 'https://localhost:8443', tls: { rejectUnauthorized: false } });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'ping' });
```
